reason: README offers a CLI inference script (inference.sh) with bundled demo assets and public non-gated HF checkpoints (~5GB), though the code hardcodes CUDA and needs CPU patching.
demo: Inference > Command Line Interface: ./inference.sh (scripts.inference with assets/demo1_video.mp4 + demo1_audio.wav)
goal: Get LatentSync's CLI inference (python -m scripts.inference, as in inference.sh with configs/unet/stage2_512.yaml and checkpoints/latentsync_unet.pt downloaded from ByteDance/LatentSync-1.6) to produce a lip-synced video on CPU only from a short clip of assets/demo1_video.mp4 and assets/demo1_audio.wav. The code hardcodes cuda in places, so it must be made to run on CPU (float32). It must accept --video_path, --audio_path, --video_out_path, --inference_steps and --guidance_scale as in inference.sh.
check: Running the inference CLI on a 1.6-second clip of the demo video/audio produces an output mp4 with sensible size, resolution, frame count and an audio track.
